projects.seoDescription: Discover AEINY initiatives including Parque del Migrante in Cuenca and the 1st Cuencano Gathering in New York.
projects.heroTitle: Ideas rooted in community. Built for lasting meaning.
projects.heroDescription: Explore initiatives that connect migration, collective memory, cultural identity and the future of communities in New York and Ecuador.
projects.introCopy: AEINY's projects recognize the contributions of migrants, preserve collective memory and create ways for communities in New York and Ecuador to stay connected.
projects.parqueLead: A place of recognition for the courage, work and contributions of Ecuadorian migrants.
projects.parqueCopy1: Parque del Migrante is an initiative presented by AEINY to honor the experience and contributions of Ecuadorian migrants. The project envisions a public space in Cuenca dedicated to memory, cultural identity and connection between communities at home and abroad.
projects.parqueCopy2: A publicly presented design includes concepts for an entrance, museum, acoustic performance space, fountain and supporting facilities.
projects.visionTitle: A vision of recognition, memory and connection

recognition.title: Recognition
recognition.copy: Honoring the work and sacrifices of migrants.

memory.title: Memory
memory.copy: Keeping migration stories visible across generations.

connection.title: Connection
connection.copy: Creating a symbolic bridge between Ecuador and its communities abroad.

projects.galleryTitle: A public space imagined through its details
projects.encuentroLead: Connecting the Cuencano community through dialogue, identity and shared opportunities.
projects.encuentroCopy1: The first Cuencano gathering in New York brought together members of the community around concerns affecting migrants, opportunities for entrepreneurship and employment, and ideas for future initiatives in Cuenca.
projects.encuentroCopy2: Its published objectives included discussing the community's situation, exploring future projects in Cuenca and organizing representation in the Ecuadorian cultural parade.
projects.eventPhotoAlt: Community members gathered at the 1st Cuencano Gathering in New York.
projects.eventPhotoCaption: A community gathering documented in AEINY's local archive.
projects.archivalPosterAlt: Archival poster for the 1st Cuencano Gathering in New York.
projects.impactTitle: Projects that connect people, places and memory.
projects.impactCopy: Whether recognizing the contributions of migrants or creating spaces for community dialogue, AEINY's initiatives seek to preserve shared histories, strengthen connections and support collective participation.
projects.finalTitle: Meaningful projects need people who believe in them.
projects.finalCopy: Learn how to collaborate with AEINY or support the development of community initiatives.

projectParque.seoTitle: Parque del Migrante | AEINY Community Project
projectParque.seoDescription: Discover Parque del Migrante, an AEINY initiative in Cuenca honoring Ecuadorian migrants through memory, cultural identity and community connection.
projectParque.title: Parque del Migrante
projectParque.intro: A community-centered initiative rooted in cultural belonging, memory, and public space.
projectParque.copy1: This project is part of AEINY’s broader effort to support community memory, belonging, and public cultural space.
projectParque.copy2: The current foundation focuses on the planning and community context behind the project rather than detailed program design.
